opening.argument: The video walks viewers through signing in to GDAX with Coinbase credentials, completing ID verification, transferring funds, and placing a Bitcoin buy order. The speaker reports the resulting fee as 12 cents, consistent with the stated purpose of reducing Coinbase fees. Those are observable steps in an account and trading tutorial, not a concrete guaranteed-profit claim or a request to send money directly to the creators. The description does include a Coinbase referral offer and promotes other cryptocurrency platforms, but that promotion does not, on this record, establish deceptive solicitation.
